svg.title: How OTSR works, in four stages
svg.desc: An image with an edge; a uniform mesh that optimal transport packs along the edge; one anisotropic Gaussian per mesh cell, elongated along the edge; and the result shown at 8× next to bicubic, with a crisp edge.
svg.text: Sinkhorn on the GPU moves a uniform
mesh onto it; cells pack along edges.
Gaussian; Adam fits all nine parameters.
exported at any size, edges kept crisp.
EVERY STAGE RUNS ON YOUR OWN GPU THROUGH WEBGPU · NO SERVER · NO UPLOAD · NO NEURAL NETWORK WEIGHTS
